data.what_it_does: Polycab India is an Indian manufacturer of wires and cables, with fast-moving electrical goods (FMEG) such as fans, lighting, switches, and solar inverters, plus EPC infrastructure projects.

segments.name: Wires and Cables
segments.comment: 47% revenue growth; EBIT margin 14.2% in the quarter.
segments.quote: The Wires and Cables segment delivered a strong quarter, recording 47% year-on-year revenue growth.

segments.name: FMEG
segments.comment: 124% growth; EBIT margin crossed 10% for the first time at 10.1%.
segments.quote: The FMEG segment delivered a breakthrough quarter, registering a remarkable 124% year-on-year growth

segments.name: EPC
segments.comment: Revenue INR 6,171 million, up 53%; EBIT margin 7.2%.
segments.quote: The EPC segment reported revenues of INR 6,171 million in Q2 FY27, representing a healthy year-on-year growth of 53%.

guidance.statement: Wires and Cables medium- to long-term EBITDA margin to stay within 11% to 13% guided range.
guidance.quote: we remain confident of sustaining medium- to long-term EBITDA margins within our guided range of 11% to 13%

guidance.statement: FMEG to grow at 1.5x to 2x industry growth rate while steadily enhancing profitability.
guidance.quote: Our objective continues to be growing at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth rate while steadily enhancing profitability.
